source.title: Template:Data Illaoi/Prophet of an Elder God

params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, a {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} will spawn next to nearby [[terrain]]. It can be killed by enemy basic attacks and will become dormant if {{ci|Illaoi}} leaves it alone.
params.blurb2: A {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} only attacks through '''Illaoi's''' abilities and does so by slamming the ground once, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. Whenever it hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}}, '''Illaoi''' is {{tip|heal|healed}} for a portion of {{as|her '''missing''' health}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Illaoi''' spawns a {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} on the nearest terrain, if no other Tentacle is around it. Tentacles fully spawn after a 2 second delay and are {{tip|untargetable}} in the meantime.
params.description2:
{{as|Tentacles|buzzword2}} are commanded to attack by '''Illaoi's''' {{tip|abilities}}, dealing {{as|{{pplevel|9 to 180}} {{as|(+ 110% AD)}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}} physical damage|physical damage}} to all enemies struck, increased by {{pp|0;10 to 30|0 to 5 for 6|key=%|formula=100% + 10% at rank 1, then 5% per rank|type = [[File:Tentacle Smash.png|20px|link=]] Tentacle Smash's rank}}.
Each enemy individually reduces the slam damage by 50% for every slam they were hit by in the last {{fd|0.66}} seconds, capped at 75% less damage.
params.description3: Each {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} also {{tip|heal|heals}} '''Illaoi''' for {{as|5% of her '''missing''' health}} if it hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}}.
params.effect radius: {{tt|1000|Range around a tentacle within which Illaoi cannot spawn a tentacle in.}}
params.differences:
'''General'''
* '''Illaoi''' has a 1200 radius to detect a nearby terrain to spawn a {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} on [https://www.reddit.com/r/leagueoflegends/comments/1n0y38y/pbe_datamine_2025_august_26_arena_changes_and/naubt4u/]. On {{tip|Summoner's Rift}}, every point on the map has a terrain that is within that radius, thus effectively allowing '''Illaoi''' to spawn a {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} from anywhere. The same may not apply for all maps.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ai|Prophet of an Elder God|Illaoi|{{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}}}} damage is increased.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Illaoi}} slams down a {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Illaoi''' slams down a {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} in the target direction.
params.description3: '''''Illaoi''' {{tip|sight|reveals}} herself during the cast if there is an enemy champion {{tt|nearby|see details}}''.
params.tips: * Since ''Tentacle Smash'' is still considered a {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} for {{ais|I|Illaoi}} damage reduction, care should be taken around {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} attack sequences, as using the ability at innapropriate times may greatly reduce not only its own damage, but also the damage of following {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} attacks. [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S7Hfd4i9nmo]

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{cis|Illaoi}} next basic attack gains {{sti|'''bonus''' attack range}} and causes her to {{tip|dash|leap}} to her target, dealing {{as|'''additional''' physical damage|physical damage}} and commanding nearby {{as|Tentacles|buzzword2}} to attack the target.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Illaoi''' empowers her next {{tip|basic attack}} within 6 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|225 '''bonus''' range}} and cause her to {{tip|dash|leap}} to the target's location if they are beyond her normal basic attack range.
params.description2: The attack deals {{as|'''additional''' physical damage|physical damage}}, with a minimum threshold, and capped at 300 against non-champions, and commands all {{as|Tentacles|buzzword2}} in range to attack the target. The minimum '''additional''' damage can also be applied against {{tip|turrets}}.
params.leveling2:
{{st|Additional Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|3 to 5}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|3.5}}% per 100 AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health|health}}}}
{{st|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|20 to 60}}}}
params.description3:
''Harsh Lesson {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Illaoi's''' basic attack timer.
Harsh Lesson can be activated during '''Illaoi's''' other abilities.
If the ''leap'' is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}, the ability is cancelled and put on cooldown.''
params.tips: * Since the mana of an ability is consumed at the end of cast time, '''Illaoi''' may still cast ''Harsh Lesson'' mid cast time of her other abilities even if her remaining mana were only enough for that other ability - potentially casting both for the price of one.

leveling.label: Additional Physical Damage
leveling.raw: {{as|{{ap|3 to 5}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|3.5}}% per 100 AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health|health}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Illaoi}} reaches with a tendril in the target direction that stops upon the first enemy hit. If the target is a {{tip|champion}}, she rips their {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} out from them to stand before her.
params.blurb2: The {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} {{tip|tether|tethers}} to the target for a duration, dealing a portion of any damage it takes. If the {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} is killed or the target leaves its range, the target will be {{tip|slow|slowed}} and marked as a {{as|Vessel|buzzword3}} for a duration or until they {{tip|takedown}} '''Illaoi''', spawning {{as|Tentacles|buzzword2}} while marked.
params.blurb3: {{as|Tentacles|buzzword2}} will autonomously attack the nearest {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} or {{as|Vessel|buzzword3}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Illaoi''' launches a tendril in the target direction that stops at the first enemy hit, pulling their {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} out in front of '''Illaoi''' over {{fd|0.75}} seconds if they are a {{tip|champion}}. The target is {{tip|tether|tethered}} to the {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} for {{tt|7 seconds|Timer starts when the target is hit}}, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them in addition to granting {{tip|sight}} of the area around them while the tether remains.
params.description2: The {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} spawns with the target's '''current''' {{sti|health|{{as|health}}}}, {{sti|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|magic resist}}}}, and echoes a portion of the {{tt|pre-mitigation damage|Damage calculated before modifiers}} received to the tethered champion, with the last hits before it dies {{tt|potentially|See notes}} echoing reduced damage.
params.description3: When the {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} is killed or the target leaves tether range, the tether is severed, marking the target as a {{as|Vessel|buzzword3}} for 4 seconds and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 80% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds once the tether returns back to them. Each {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} autonomously attacks the closest {{as|Vessel|buzzword3}} or {{as|Spirit|buzzword}}, prioritizing the latter, once every {{pp|4.5 to 3.5 for 3|1 to 13|formula=4-0.5 every 6 levels, with an up to 0.5-second delay. Cooldown starts upon starting the slam.}} seconds.
params.description4: Enemies made a {{as|Vessel|buzzword3}} continuously spawn a {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} near themselves, when possible. {{as|Tentacles|buzzword2}} can spawn 300 units closer to each other than when spawned by '''Illaoi'''.
params.description5: '''''Illaoi''' is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} while firing the projectile and while the target's {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} is being pulled. She also {{tip|sight|reveals}} herself while firing the projectile if there is an enemy champion {{tt|nearby|See notes}}. {{as|Vessels|buzzword3}} can dispel their mark by scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against '''Illaoi'''. Test of Spirit cannot be cast again until the {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} dies.''
params.range: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 950|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|100|Distance in front of Illaoi the Spirit is pulled to}}}}
params.tether radius: {{dv|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|1500|Actual tether. Equivalent to 1630 center-to-center range against the average champion who breaks the range when their outer edge touches the indicator range.}}|{{tip|cr|icononly=true}} {{tt|1700|Static indicator}}}}
params.tips:
* Other than [[area of effect]]s, since damage amplifiers (e.g {{ri|Last Stand}}), {{bi|Aspect of the Dragon}} burn damage, and {{ai|The Darkin Scythe A|Shadow Assassin|The Darkin Scythe}} apply on the {{as|Spirit|Buzzword}} and the {{as|Vessel|buzzword3}} individually and as separate instances of damage, their '''bonus''' damage through the echo is effectively enhanced. In particular, damage amplifiers and ''The Darkin Scyte'' will further apply on their own echoed '''bonus''' damage. [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SbH-Heiee0E]
** The same does not apply for effects that apply post-mitigation (e.g {{ii|Abyssal Mask}}, {{ii|Bloodsong}}).

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Illaoi}} becomes {{tip|displacement immunity|unstoppable}} before dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies. For each enemy {{tip|champion}} hit, a {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} is summoned around her for a period.
params.blurb2: For the duration, ''{{ais|Harsh Lesson|Illaoi}}'' cooldown is {{sti|ah|reduced}} and nearby {{as|Tentacles|buzzword2}} attack faster.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Illaoi''' gains {{tip|displacement immunity}} and leaps into the air for the cast time. She then slams her idol into the ground, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies. For each enemy champion hit, a {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} is summoned for 8 seconds (up to a maximum of 6 summons).
params.description2: For the duration, ''{{ais|Harsh Lesson|Illaoi}}'' {{sti|cooldown}} is halved, all {{as|Tentacles|buzzword2}} awakened by '''Illaoi''' are {{tip|untargetable}}, will not show their hitboxes, nor go dormant, and will take {{fd|0.5}} seconds to make an attack; however they will then incur a lockout of {{fd|0.5}} seconds before being able to start a new attack.
params.description3: ''This does not affect the {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} attack from {{ai|Tentacle Smash|Illaoi}}.''
